focus.title: 美国BIS拟修订外国直接产品规则，扩大对华半导体设备出口管制
focus.summary: 美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）于7月10日发布预通知，拟修订外国直接产品规则，将特定半导体制造设备纳入管控范围。新规旨在堵塞现有漏洞，防止通过第三国转运规避制裁。中企需核查供应链中是否涉及美国原产技术，评估对设备采购和代工合作的影响。
focus.title_en: U.S. BIS Proposes to Expand Foreign Direct Product Rules on Semiconductor Equipment to China
focus.summary_en: On July 10, the U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) issued an advance notice of proposed rulemaking to amend the foreign direct product rules, expanding controls to certain semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The revision aims to close loopholes that allow diversion through third countries. Chinese companies should review their supply chains for U.S.-origin technology and assess impacts on equipment procurement and foundry partnerships.

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决：合同未明确仲裁条款，但双方行为可推定仲裁合意
case.summary: 2026年6月，SIAC在一起中马合资纠纷中裁定，虽主合同未包含仲裁条款，但双方在争议发生后共同参与SIAC管理的调解程序并约定“调解不成则仲裁”，构成有效仲裁协议。该裁决强调仲裁合意的灵活性，提示企业注意争议解决条款的明确性，避免因模糊表述导致管辖权争议。
case.title_en: SIAC Award: Arbitration Agreement Inferred from Parties' Conduct Despite No Express Clause in Contract
case.summary_en: In June 2026, the Singapore International Arbitration Center (SIAC) ruled in a China-Malaysia joint venture dispute that, although the main contract lacked an arbitration clause, the parties' joint participation in SIAC-administered mediation and agreement to arbitrate if mediation failed constituted a valid arbitration agreement. The award highlights the flexibility of arbitration consent and reminds businesses to ensure clarity in dispute resolution clauses to avoid jurisdictional disputes.
case.source_en: Source: SIAC Award No. 18 of 2026 · June 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动“白名单”机制正式落地，首批涵盖金融与医疗
policy.summary: 广东省网信办联合港澳相关部门于7月10日发布《粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动安全管理规定》，建立“白名单”制度，对列入清单的数据类型（如个人信用信息、健康档案）在区域内自由流动提供简化审批。企业需按标准进行数据分类分级，并完成数据出境安全评估备案。
policy.title_en: GBA Cross-Border Data Flow 'Whitelist' Mechanism Takes Effect, First Batch Covers Finance and Healthcare
policy.summary_en: On July 10, the Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong, together with Hong Kong and Macao authorities, issued the 'Regulations on the Administration of Cross-Border Data Flow in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area,' establishing a whitelist system. Data types listed (e.g., personal credit information, health records) enjoy simplified approval for free flow within the region. Companies must classify data according to standards and complete security assessment filings for data exports.

analysis.title: 欧盟《外国补贴条例》调查趋严，中企应主动审查并建立合规档案
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟委员会近期依据《外国补贴条例》对多家中资企业展开深度调查，重点关注并购交易中的政府补贴。建议企业提前梳理三年内接受的各类政府资助（包括税收优惠、低息贷款），建立补贴台账；在交易前主动向欧委会进行自愿申报，降低被处罚风险。
analysis.title_en: EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation Scrutiny Intensifies: Chinese Companies Should Proactively Review and Build Compliance Records
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The European Commission has recently launched in-depth investigations into several Chinese companies under the Foreign Subsidies Regulation, focusing on government subsidies in M&A transactions. Companies are advised to compile records of all government support (including tax incentives, low-interest loans) received in the past three years, establish a subsidy ledger, and voluntarily notify the Commission before transactions to mitigate penalty risks.
